subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live v2026.6.11 or current-main packaged-gateway reproduction before authorizing changes to tool-output caps or Skill Workshop persistence?
rationale: The inspected source and shipped release caps are much higher than the reported cutoff, while the remaining plausible causes span display sanitization, transcript replay, context projection, provider-native web search, and workspace-scoped proposal lookup.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a packaged Linux gateway transcript or maintainer Crabbox run that captures the exact truncation and proposal lookup failure.

options.title: Start Source Investigation Now
options.body: Assign an owner to trace display, transcript, context-projection, provider-native search, and Skill Workshop workspace scoping without waiting for reporter proof.

options.title: Split The Read-Only Symptom
options.body: Treat read truncation as partially covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84659 and keep this issue focused on multi-tool output plus Skill Workshop state if fresh evidence connects them.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a packaged Linux gateway transcript or maintainer Crabbox run that captures the exact truncation and proposal lookup failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest non-shallow history signal is the June live tool-result and agent-tool cap work, which overlaps most of the output-truncation symptom.
